file: 474 Roblox AI Tool Build Has Made Over 70000 Games.mp4

lines.t: Roblox's new AI tool has already published over seventy thousand games.

full.credit: Clips: RICHLEV GAMING; Cocajola; Ropilot AI (YouTube)

lines.t: It's called Build, and it turns a text prompt into a playable game.

full.credit: Clips: RICHLEV GAMING; Cocajola; Ropilot AI (YouTube)

lines.t: More than five hundred thousand people have tried it since July.

full.credit: Clips: RICHLEV GAMING; Cocajola; Ropilot AI (YouTube)

lines.t: So far it's only live in New Zealand, Singapore, Serbia and Thailand.

full.credit: Clips: RICHLEV GAMING; Cocajola; Ropilot AI (YouTube)

lines.t: Roblox says AI games are ranked by player retention, like every other game.

full.credit: Clips: RICHLEV GAMING; Cocajola; Ropilot AI (YouTube)
